resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Turkish source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Turkish pass identified 25 actionable formula, terminology, grammar, formatting, and technical-clarity defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Turkish human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted for this cycle.

findings.summary: The Ohm-law section title was incorrectly lowercased.
evidence: The previous title was ilişki.
findings.resolution: Capitalized it as the Turkish heading İlişki.

findings.summary: The voltage definition used the less consistent voltaj term.
evidence: The previous text defined V as voltaj.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the preferred electrical term gerilim.

findings.summary: The current definition redundantly said amper or amper.
evidence: The previous text contained amper veya amper.
findings.resolution: Reduced it to the standard amper term.

findings.summary: The current formula translated the variable I as the Turkish word ben.
evidence: The previous formula began ben = 4,2 V.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected mathematical variable I.

findings.summary: The power paragraph translated heat dissipation as thermal capacity and clearance.
evidence: The previous text used termal kapasiteye ve boşluk payına.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with ısı yayma kapasitesi and güvenlik payı.

findings.summary: The milliampere conversion omitted spaces around the unit symbols.
evidence: The previous value was 1mA = 0,001A.
findings.resolution: Formatted it as 1 mA = 0,001 A.

findings.summary: The worked-example heading was a literal phrase rather than a natural Turkish technical heading.
evidence: The previous title was Çalışılan örnek.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Hesaplama örneği.

findings.summary: The energy formula localized the SI second symbol as sn.
evidence: The previous formula used 10 sn.
findings.resolution: Restored the stable SI symbol s.

findings.summary: The safety paragraph used physical clearance for safety margin.
evidence: The previous text recommended boşluk payı.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the safety-specific term güvenlik payı.

findings.summary: The circuit branch was translated as dal instead of the established Turkish term kol.
evidence: The previous definition began Dal, iki düğüm arasındaki.
findings.resolution: Changed the circuit term to Kol and clarified that it carries current.

findings.summary: The loop definition used çevre, which was ambiguous in this circuit context.
evidence: The previous definition used Bir çevre.
findings.resolution: Used the clearer circuit term Çevrim.

findings.summary: The series-connection definition used an awkward literal phrase about giving current a path.
evidence: The previous text said akıma bileşenler arasında yalnızca bir yol verir.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as providing one path for current.

findings.summary: The total-resistance formula translated the protected variable name into Turkish.
evidence: The previous formula used R_toplam.
findings.resolution: Restored the stable calculation variable R_total.

findings.summary: The series-current formula translated the variable I into ben and used inconsistent decimal formatting.
evidence: The previous formula used ben = 8,0 V / 0,40 Ω = 20 A.
findings.resolution: Restored I and kept the formula variables and SI units intact.

findings.summary: The voltage example used a dot decimal despite the locale's comma decimal convention.
evidence: The previous formula began +8.0 V.
findings.resolution: Changed it to +8,0 V.

findings.summary: The parallel-branch annotation remained in English inside an otherwise Turkish formula.
evidence: The previous annotation ended with (parallel branches).
findings.resolution: Changed the annotation to (paralel kollar).

findings.summary: The circuit-analysis heading used solve literally instead of the natural Turkish analysis wording.
evidence: The previous title was Gerçek devreleri çözme.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Gerçek devreleri analiz etme.

findings.summary: The checklist used branş, an inconsistent loanword for circuit branches.
evidence: The previous bullet used branş akımlarını.
findings.resolution: Changed it to kol akımlarını and made the instruction more direct.

findings.summary: The resistor relationship used voltaj instead of the preferred gerilim term.
evidence: The previous bullet said Direnç voltajını ve akımını.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as Direnç üzerindeki gerilim ve akımı.

findings.summary: The TCR setup contained a malformed control character before the Celsius unit.
evidence: The previous setup rendered an invalid character in the temperature value.
findings.resolution: Replaced the malformed value with a clean 20 °C statement.

findings.summary: The right-triangle explanation contained awkward and incomplete definitions of the sides.
evidence: The previous text ended with the malformed phrase teğet karşıt bitişik komşudur.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with explicit Turkish definitions and a clear SOH-CAH-TOA reminder.

findings.summary: The trigonometry setup used an unnatural literal description of an angle.
evidence: The previous setup said hipotenüs 30°'lik bir açıyla buluşuyor.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural statement that the hypotenuse makes a 30° angle.

findings.summary: The sine function was translated as the Turkish word for sin, corrupting the formula.
evidence: The previous formula used günah(30°).
findings.resolution: Restored the mathematical function sin(30°).

findings.summary: The heat-capacity formula omitted the temperature difference symbol.
evidence: The previous formula was C = Q / T.
findings.resolution: Restored the correct relation C = Q / ΔT.

findings.summary: The TCR worked-example heading used a literal phrase rather than a natural Turkish technical heading.
evidence: The previous title was Çalışılan örnek.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Hesaplama örneği.
